about: Settings for the piece checker (conform.mjs) and the two gates that run it: the Sentry's rich check at git push, and the public build. While enforce is false a gate reports and never blocks; the checker runs report-only over every web page until its false alarms are tuned out (STIGMERGY — spec — rich-face pieces § 5). Turning enforce on is Loudon's call. not_pieces names pages that are never served as a piece. allow holds reviewed exceptions: piece, rule, the finding's key, and why it is fine.

not_pieces.why: the renderer itself: it frames pieces, it is not one
STIGMERGY's app shell, built by Vite
the app's own static files, served by Vite on its origin, never as a piece
the rating page of eval-server.mjs, served by that server with its own /eval API, never as a piece
design mockups for the app, viewed through Vite against the app's own root (/fonts/), never as a piece
a template a script fills in to make a page (its data is a placeholder like /*__DATA__*/); as written it is never served as a piece
